# Known-failing tests on main. See docs/decisions/ADR-003-required-test-aggregator.md
#
# One node id per line; `flaky <node id>` is exempt from the stale check in
# both directions. One-way ratchet: an entry that runs and passes fails the
# gate until it is deleted, and an addition needs an exact-head review receipt
# (pr-scope-guard). History of the entries that used to be here: git log.
#
# 2026-10-01: emptied. Every one of the 21 entries passed or no longer existed.
# Twelve had been passing or deleted for weeks without the ratchet noticing,
# because their files are in .github/heavy-test-files.txt and the heavy job is
# red at baseline, so its stale report was never read. Five of those had
# meanwhile started failing again behind the ledger: the install idempotence
# gate (#3989) made a repeat install of identical content exit before the
# service-state check those tests drive. The rest were tests that were wrong
# about the code, not the reverse: a rename sweep's `createTinyAssetsDispatch`,
# a symlink test that resolve()d its own symlink away, and two tray files that
# died at collection on a headless runner (now pystray's dummy backend).
